<reason>CON won the live comparison: after both sides treated heavy outsourcing as a fail and logs as fakeable, the motion’s remaining effect is to make middle-zone offloading compliant and to send an open-door message. PRO never showed disclosure creates the struggle or that teachers can verify process at scale; “fail the empty room you can see” was sharp but did not beat CON’s incentive/norm and exception-swallows-the-rule weighing.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON turning PRO’s A1 (a truthful “thesis/outline/draft by model” log earns incomplete) into the self-incriminating-log point: heavy users then falsify, so secrecy returns and the motion mainly legalizes the middle-zone skip.</best_rebuttal>
